title: Real-time Seat Holds, POS Terminal Sales & Automated Reconciliations
summary: Introduced high-concurrency seat reservation locks with automated 30-minute hold timers, a physical POS terminal module for branch cashiers, and automated bank reconciliation reports.

changes.text: Interactive Point of Sale (POS) terminal for quick on-site pilgrim booking and immediate receipt printing
changes.author: MusfiqDehan

changes.text: Automated BullMQ background job for releasing expired seat reservations back into tier quotas
changes.author: MusfiqDehan

changes.text: Modern Changelog and Live Healthcheck Status pages with automated GitHub release integrations
changes.author: MusfiqDehan

changes.text: Ensure accurate seat counter increments during concurrent checkout sessions
changes.author: MusfiqDehan

changes.text: Redis cached tenant versioning to invalidate schema cache in under 2ms
changes.author: MusfiqDehan

title: Vendor SAR/BDT Disbursements & Multi-Currency Accounting Hub
summary: Full financial management suite for Hajj & Umrah operators, featuring dual-currency (SAR and BDT) vendor disbursements, batch hotel payouts, and pilgrim installment schedules.

changes.text: Dual-currency expense tracking for Makkah and Madinah hotel vendor disbursements
changes.author: MusfiqDehan

changes.text: Flexible installment scheduler with automated SMS and email reminder notifications
changes.author: MusfiqDehan

changes.text: Branch-scoped financial visibility: restricts cashier roles to assigned branch transactions only
changes.author: MusfiqDehan

changes.text: Fixed decimal precision rounding for SAR to BDT currency conversion on bulk settlements
changes.author: MusfiqDehan

title: Dynamic Payment Gateway Adapters with SSLCommerz & Stripe
summary: Pluggable payment architecture enabling tenants to link their own SSLCommerz merchant accounts or Stripe keys, with automated webhooks and branch manual collections.

changes.text: Multi-gateway adapter strategy supporting SSLCommerz, Stripe, and in-branch cash collection
changes.author: MusfiqDehan

changes.text: Automated webhook retry queue with cryptographic signature verification
changes.author: MusfiqDehan

changes.text: Optimized database connection pooling under high-load booking bursts
changes.author: MusfiqDehan

changes.text: Resolved callback redirection issue on mobile banking bKash/Nagad checkout sheets
changes.author: MusfiqDehan

title: Isolated Tenant Schemas & Custom Domain Edge Routing
summary: Enterprise data isolation architecture giving every agency a dedicated PostgreSQL schema (t_<slug>) and custom domain routing powered by Traefik v3 with automated Let's Encrypt TLS.

changes.text: Schema-per-tenant architecture ensuring complete data privacy and isolated booking records
changes.author: MusfiqDehan

changes.text: Dynamic Traefik SSL certificate provisioning for custom agency domains
changes.author: MusfiqDehan

changes.text: AsyncLocalStorage context resolver guaranteeing zero cross-tenant query leakage
changes.author: MusfiqDehan

changes.text: Automated schema migration script runner for multi-tenant deployments
changes.author: MusfiqDehan

title: Initial Launch of Wufud SaaS Platform
summary: Official launch of the modern, cloud-native Hajj & Umrah booking platform, purpose-built for agency operators and pilgrims.

changes.text: Package builder with multi-tier pricing, hotel allocations, and airline routing
changes.author: MusfiqDehan

changes.text: Pilgrim portal with family group bookings and passport/visa document upload
changes.author: MusfiqDehan

changes.text: Role-based access control with Headquarter and branch-specific permissions
changes.author: MusfiqDehan

changes.text: Modern, calm responsive UI crafted with Tailwind CSS and dark mode support
changes.author: MusfiqDehan
